svg.title: Budgets and reporting responsibility
svg.desc: Budgets and reporting responsibility. How do detailed budget drivers differ from a cost-center summary? Primary tables: CostCenter, Budget, BudgetLine. Some BudgetLine rows have no CostCenterID. Budget and BudgetLine are separate grains; do not join their amounts as if they were matching individual transactions.
